summary: Specifies the format of RDMA Connection Manager private data exchanged between RPC-over-RDMA version 1 peers when establishing a connection. It is an optional extension that does not change the version 1 protocol and updates RFC 8166.

eli5.summary: When two computers shake hands, they can pass a little extra note. This says what the note looks like.

questions: how do rpc-over-rdma peers exchange connection details
